_comment: Coding agents under evaluation. Each value is a shell command run with cwd set to an ISOLATED copy of the task's workdir. Env available: $PROMPT (task.md contents), $TASK_DIR (the task root, e.g. for a solution/), $TASK_ID. The command must make the fix in-place using files in the cwd. Real-agent runs spend real API quota/time and are ON-DEMAND only (never CI, never scheduled). Model selection is left to each CLI's own config so the $0 gateway routing applies. The two mock-* agents apply/skip the known fix and exist so the harness itself can be validated at $0.
